price_terms.name: affordable budget range
price_terms.instruction: Treat affordable, cheap, budget, low price, low cost, and inexpensive as PriceRange.tier values matching budget, low, cheap, or affordable. Prefer ordering by PriceRange.avg_price ASC when available.

price_terms.name: premium price range
price_terms.instruction: Treat premium, luxury, expensive, high end, and fine dining as PriceRange.tier values matching premium, luxury, expensive, or high.

location_terms.name: near me default radius
location_terms.instruction: When the user asks for near me or nearby results and provides browser coordinates, use a default radius of 3 km unless the user specifies a different distance.

location_terms.name: walking distance radius
location_terms.instruction: Treat walking distance and walkable as a default radius of 1 km when browser coordinates are available.

rating_terms.name: high rating
rating_terms.instruction: Treat high rating, high rated, highly rated, best, good, and top rated as Restaurant.average_rating >= 4.0 when available, and order by Restaurant.average_rating DESC then Restaurant.review_count DESC.
